Analysis: F003 is a duplicate_invoice finding. Invoice 801 duplicates 452 (same vendor, normalized invoice number, date, amount). The correction for a duplicate_invoice finding may void the duplicate (801 → V). The original journal 2445 posted the duplicate liability and expense, so a reversing journal in an open period is needed to offset it: DR 2000 23483.62 (clear AP), CR expense accounts 5400 17532.66, 5100 5950.96 — reversing the 2445 lines exactly. Period 12 (or 11) is open; I'll use period 12 as the current open period with the most recent date, since the reversal is posted now.

Note that the original journal 2445 is in period 3 (closed), so the reversal must go to an open period, which is what I'm doing.

The payment side is not involved: invoice 452 is the paid one, and 801 has no payments, so voiding 801 does not affect any payment records.
